name: Shiroi Kiseki ~White Spur~
source:
Main character starts to live alone to attend a university in Tokyo. However, his mother asks his childhood friend who came to Tokyo one year earlier to take care of protagonist. When protagonist sets to go to a snowboard training camp, his childhood friend volunteers to accompany him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角开始独自生活，去东京上大学。然而，他的母亲却委托一年前来到东京的青梅竹马来照顾主角。当主角准备去滑雪板训练营时，他儿时的朋友自愿陪伴他。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
